./chat-view.purpose: Workspace and workflow-run compose the same conversation renderer.

./composer-context-bar.purpose: Workspace places the active conversation context above its composer.

./expand-prompt-role-tokens.purpose: Both prompt submission surfaces must expand the same role references.

./markdown-message.purpose: Plugin README uses the same safe document renderer as conversation content.

./session-agent-banner.purpose: Workspace owns placement while chat owns unavailable-agent presentation.

./session-history-banner.purpose: Workspace composes chat-owned history status above the conversation.

./session-mcp-health-banner.purpose: Workspace composes chat-owned MCP health status above the conversation, scoped to that session's MCP selection.

./session-setup.purpose: Workspace records provider setup timing through chat-owned session-scoped runtime state.

./session-usage-surface.purpose: Workspace composes chat-owned volatile usage presentation in the conversation header.

./turn-diff-files.purpose: Files and workflow activity normalize displayed ACP worktree paths consistently.

./translations.purpose: The single i18n composition loads this feature's pure resource bundle.
